name: Niram Rawamunando
original_name: ニイラム・ラワヌナンド
source:
One of XFJ Project’s dedicated operators. The highest-ranking of the three operators, she keeps the team working together smoothly. She may look like she has her act together on the surface, but actually has an oddball streak and a habit of getting lost in her own delusions.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
